content: रुद्र {%a.%} [रोदिति रुद्-रक् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 22</ls>] .²1 Dreadful, terrific, frightful, formidable. .²2 Great, large. .²3 Driving away evil. .²4 Praiseworthy. .{@-द्रः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a group of gods, eleven in number, supposed to be inferior manifestations of Śiva or Śaṃkara, who is said to be the head of the group; रुद्राणां शंकरश्चास्मि <ls>Bg. 10. 23</ls>; रुद्राणामपि मूर्धानः क्षतहुंकारशंसिनः <ls>Ku. 2. 26</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²3 Fire. .²4 The number ‘eleven’. .²5 (<ab>pl.</ab>) प्राणs and इन्द्रियs; <ls>Mb. 12. 316. 5</ls> (<ab>com.</ab>). .²6 <ab>N.</ab> for the hymns addressed to Rudra.
